name: Shoulder Distraction Hold
description: Band or light cable pulls the arm away from the socket (traction) while the athlete holds a relaxed 90/90 or neutral position; cuff stays quiet, no shrug. 2-3 sets of 20-30 s per arm, after throwing or on upper days. Ruling item: no verified source for distraction training in throwers; included because the coach's arm-care standard requires it.

name: D2 Flexion Diagonal
description: Thrower's Ten diagonal pattern: band from the opposite hip, arm sweeps up and across to overhead with thumb up, then controlled return. 2-3 sets of 10-15 per arm. Source: Thrower's Ten systematic review (Patel & Vaishnav, Cureus 2025, PMID 41280985); Escamilla et al. 2012 (JSCR, PMID 22549085).

name: Scaption Raise
description: Thrower's Ten 'full can': light dumbbells, arms raised 30 degrees forward of the frontal plane to shoulder height, thumbs up, 2-3 s lowering. 2-3 sets of 10-15. Source: Patel & Vaishnav 2025 (PMID 41280985); Escamilla et al. 2012 (PMID 22549085).

name: Chair Press-Up
description: Thrower's Ten press-up: seated, hands on the chair edge, press the body up by depressing the shoulder blades, hold 2 s. 2-3 sets of 10. Source: Patel & Vaishnav 2025 (PMID 41280985).

name: Wrist Curl
description: Forearm supported, palm up, curl the wrist through full range with a 3 s lowering. 2-3 sets of 10-15. Pairs with Dumbbell Wrist Extension to balance flexor and extensor volume. Source: Thrower's Ten wrist flexion component (Patel & Vaishnav 2025, PMID 41280985).

name: Loaded Jump Lunge
description: Alternating jump lunges holding a light load (about 10 kg) for a fixed time or rep count; quiet landings, stop when height or rhythm drops. 2-3 sets of 6-10 total. Listed as a Tier 1 test in Architecture 3.2 (r = 0.369) but no supporting study was found this session -- flagged 'unsupported'.

name: Plyometric Push-Up
description: Explosive push-up with hands leaving the floor; regress to hands-elevated if landing quality fails. 3-4 sets of 3-5, full rest. Source: plyometric upper-body program raised throwing velocity in Escamilla et al. 2012 (JSCR, PMID 22549085).

name: Suitcase Carry
description: Walk 15-25 m per side with one heavy dumbbell, tall posture, no lean toward or away from the load. 3 sets per side. Anti-lateral-flexion capacity (Blueprint V3 section 6.3). Source: core training class, Lin et al. 2024 meta-analysis (PMID 38529609).

name: Jump Rope
description: 2-3 rounds of 2-3 minutes, 2-3 times a week, for ankle stiffness and foot capacity (Training Principles 3.1 section 1.1). Counts toward plyometric contacts. No pitching-specific trial; plyometric class evidence (Markovic 2007, PMID 17347316).
